A real difference between two official renditions; the record follows its canonical source, the grade 6 PDF, and equals it on the page image (page 1). (1) The export lacks five words in a row that the PDF prints in the first sentence of the clarification: a parenthesis directly after the eighth word of the clarification's text (not counting its label), which names three groups that living things include. (2) The PDF prints a double asterisk at the start of that parenthesis and another at the start of the last sentence of the clarification, and sets both passages in boldface: both are California clarification statements. The export has neither mark (the frame says so) and keeps the last sentence word for word. Nothing else differs; the export's paragraph begins and ends where the record does, and neither rendition has an assessment boundary. Code: the export's identifier has a trailing space. To report: the record has no california_addition field (no record of this lane has one), although the PDF marks two passages of this clarification as California's own; this is the only expectation of the grade 6 document with a double asterisk in its row. The Summary calls the last sentence a note marked with two asterisks but gives the parenthesis without saying it is marked too. Summary and Limits are otherwise faithful to the PDF. Nothing to fix in the wording.
